data.notes: January 2026 in Seoul was unusually dense, with arena-scale K-pop encores alongside active Itaewon and Hapjeong club programming.

events.title: 2025 BAEKHYUN WORLD TOUR ‘Reverie [dot]’
events.summary: Baekhyun played three Seoul dates at KSPO Dome for the ‘Reverie [dot]’ world tour, with performances listed for January 2, 3, and 4, 2026.

events.title: Unluckyme
events.summary: Unluckyme opened its 2026 run at Cakeshop with CCR, Shimeunboss, Citi Jeong, Ugly Duck, and Javi Suh, framed by the promoter as a ghetto-tech and bass-focused night.

events.title: 2026 HWASA CONCERT <MI CASA>
events.venueName: Kyung Hee University Grand Peace Hall
events.summary: Hwasa’s <MI CASA> concert was listed by Ticketlink for January 17 and 18, 2026 at Kyung Hee University Grand Peace Hall, organized and hosted by P NATION.

events.title: GUCHUK present: Recursion
events.summary: Guchuk Records brought Recursion to Vurt with Joshüa, Einox live, SIJIN, and Philipp Kim, with Resident Advisor flagging the event as an RA Pick.

events.title: 2026 TAEYONG CONCERT 〈TY TRACK - REMASTERED〉
events.summary: Taeyong’s SM Entertainment-backed 〈TY TRACK - REMASTERED〉 concert was scheduled for January 24 and 25, 2026 at Ticketlink Live Arena in Olympic Park.

events.title: Men I Trust Seoul Concert
events.summary: NOL World listed Men I Trust’s Seoul concert for January 24, 2026 at KBS Arena, with standing and reserved-seat tickets available.

events.title: Long Take
events.summary: Faust’s Long Take night featured Kim Bo Yeon, Stann Lumo, Suman, and theia, with the concept centered on extended storytelling sets.

events.title: Sigala Live in Seoul
events.summary: Sigala’s Seoul DJ live was confirmed for January 25, 2026 at YES24 Wanderloch Hall, with R.TEE, Juncoco, and Jeonghyeon listed as support.

events.title: 2026 MONSTA X WORLD TOUR [THE X : NEXUS]
events.summary: MONSTA X launched [THE X : NEXUS] with three KSPO Dome shows from January 30 to February 1, 2026, with the venue calendar listing Friday, Saturday, and Sunday performance times.

events.title: LE SSERAFIM TOUR ‘EASY CRAZY HOT’ ENCORE IN SEOUL
events.summary: LE SSERAFIM’s ‘EASY CRAZY HOT’ Seoul encore was ticketed through NOL World for January 31 to February 1, 2026 at Jamsil Indoor Stadium.

events.title: 2025-26 ONEW WORLD TOUR [ONEW THE LIVE : PERCENT (%)] ENCORE
events.summary: Onew’s [ONEW THE LIVE : PERCENT (%)] encore was scheduled for January 31 and February 1, 2026 at Ticketlink Live Arena in Olympic Park.

events.title: vurtnight: HVL (Bassiani / Tbilisi)
events.summary: Vurt hosted HVL of Bassiani/Tbilisi on January 31, 2026, supported by resident DJs ANSOL and SUNA for a techno-focused vurtnight.
